Messages.Author: cnislev
Messages.Body:
Couldnt find a clear answer for this on the newsgroup, so here goes:

Firebrand
Cardtext: Requires an anarch.
If this referendum is successful, put this card on the acting anarch.
This anarch gets 1 additional vote during a political action. During
your minion phase, this anarch can burn 1 blood to untap a ready
younger anarch. Burn this card if this anarch goes to torpor. An
anarch may have only 1 Firebrand.

1. How does the timing work? Can it be used during an action? During
combat? (if youre getting torp'ed you might as well spend your blood
on something useful...)

2. If an anarch A calls Domain Challenge, can an older anarch B with
Firebrand untap anarch A before the vote resolves, so that I dont lose
pool for anarch A being tapped? My playgroup said no...

3. An anarch A calls Anarch Salon. Can another anarch B on full
capacity use Firebrand to untap a younger anarch X, thereby spending
one blood, before the Anarch Salon resolves and gives a blood to
anarch B (bringing it back to full capacity again?).

And completely unrelated:

4. What happens if I (e.g. involuntarily) transfers in a vampire that
I already have in play? e.g. enchant kindred and then forgets to
transfer back to my pool... Does it burn?

Thank you

Messages.Author: adam....@gmail.com
Messages.Body:



The second one burns (assume unique). The exception to this is Jimmy
Dunn.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cnislev wrote:
> Couldnt find a clear answer for this on the newsgroup, so here goes:
>
> Firebrand
> Cardtext: Requires an anarch.
> If this referendum is successful, put this card on the acting anarch.
> This anarch gets 1 additional vote during a political action. During
> your minion phase, this anarch can burn 1 blood to untap a ready
> younger anarch. Burn this card if this anarch goes to torpor. An

>
> 1. How does the timing work?

"During your minion phase" is the only timing restriction given.

> Can it be used during an action? During
> combat? (if youre getting torp'ed you might as well spend your blood
> on something useful...)

Yes.

> 2. If an anarch A calls Domain Challenge, can an older anarch B with
> Firebrand untap anarch A before the vote resolves, so that I dont lose
> pool for anarch A being tapped? My playgroup said no...

Yes.
B could untap A before blocks were solicited, even.

> 3. An anarch A calls Anarch Salon. Can another anarch B on full
> capacity use Firebrand to untap a younger anarch X, thereby spending
> one blood, before the Anarch Salon resolves and gives a blood to
> anarch B (bringing it back to full capacity again?).

Yes (same as 2 above)

> And completely unrelated:
>
> 4. What happens if I (e.g. involuntarily) transfers in a vampire that
> I already have in play? e.g. enchant kindred and then forgets to
> transfer back to my pool... Does it burn?

Yes, the incoming copy that would be self-contested burns.
